papers.title: <b>MICROSTRUCTURE AND MECHANICAL PROPERTIES OF TI-6AL-4V ALLOY FABRICATED BY WIRE ARC ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING</b>
papers.abstract: The paper presents a systematized analytical synthesis of the current body of experimental data regarding the arc additive manufacturing of Ti-6Al-4V titanium alloy, focusing on Wire Arc (WAAM) and Gas Tungsten Arc (GTAW-AM) technologies. WAAM is an arc-based additive manufacturing technology derived from conventional welding processes. The synthesis focuses on quantitative relationships between deposition parameters, thermal cycling effects, microstructural evolution, and anisotropy of mechanical properties. It is demonstrated that heat input control, interpass temperature, and deposition path strategy govern prior-β grain growth and α-phase morphology. Repeated thermal exposure inherent to layer-by-layer deposition promotes the formation of columnar prior-β grains aligned with the build direction and height-dependent α-lath coarsening, resulting in hardness gradients and anisotropy of tensile strength. Optimized GTAW-AM parameters ensure geometric stability of deposited beads and tensile strength exceeding 900 MPa. For the WAAM process under controlled interpass temperature conditions, the formation of refined Widmanstätten-type lamellar structures is characteristic, contributing to improved strength. In addition, comparative analysis of mechanical properties reveals pronounced anisotropy in ultimate tensile strength, yield strength, and elongation depending on specimen orientation relative to the build direction. Typical technological defects inherent to arc-based additive manufacturing, including porosity, residual stresses, and microstructural heterogeneity, are associated with heat input and cooling conditions. The findings define a consistent process–structure–property relationship for arc-based additive manufacturing of Ti-6Al-4V and provide a scientifically grounded basis for optimization of arc-based AM technologies for critical structural components.

summary_en.motivation: To systematically synthesize the current body of experimental data on the process-structure-property relationships of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by wire arc additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: Analytical synthesis of existing experimental data focusing on deposition parameters, thermal cycling, microstructural evolution, and mechanical anisotropy.
summary_en.result: Identified that heat input, interpass temperature, and deposition strategy govern prior-β grain growth and α-phase morphology, leading to anisotropy in tensile strength and hardness.
summary_en.validation: No new validation; the study is a review based on previously published experimental results.

papers.title: Investigation into the microstructure and fatigue property of selective electronic beaming melted TC4 alloy with different heating treatments
papers.abstract: Abstract Abstract：The additive manufacturing of TC4 titanium alloy demonstrates considerable potential in the aerospace and surgical orthopaedic materials sectors. However, the reliability of the mechanical properties of electron beam selective melting (SEBM) parts is a prerequisite for the future mass production of such components. This paper presents a systematic study of the effects of solution and aging treatment (SAT) on the microstructure and fatigue properties of additively manufactured TC4 titanium alloy. The results demonstrate that the deposition layer is predominantly composed of the α phase and β columnar crystals. The β columnar crystal, aligned with the building direction, traverses multiple deposition layers. Following the SAT treatment, an increase in the size of the α phase was observed. Upon reaching a solution temperature of 950 °C, the basketweave structure undergoes a transformation into a lamellar structure. As the temperature rises, the microstructure of the alloy undergoes a coarsening process, accompanied by a reduction in hardness and an increase in plasticity.As anticipated, the tensile strength and plasticity of the SAT sample have been observed to exhibit a certain degree of enhancement. In comparison to the deposited TC4 titanium alloy, the SAT sample displays enhanced fatigue strength and an extended fatigue life, indicative of heightened resilience to fatigue fracture. This paper presents a study of the uniaxial fatigue data for SEBM titanium alloy, with a particular focus on the relationship between the heat treatment process and the fatigue limit. This study examines the impact of the specific texture of additive manufacturing titanium alloy on the fatigue failure mechanism and fatigue life. A comparison was made between the properties of EBAM titanium alloy and those of conventionally manufactured Ti-6Al-4V, and potential methods for enhancing its fatigue resistance were discussed.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了Ti-6Al-4V（TC4）电子束熔融沉积件的固溶时效热处理对其微观组织和疲劳性能的影响，直接对应后处理控制方向。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not cover other post-processing methods such as HIP, shot peening, or machining, and does not include uncertainty quantification or patient-specific considerations.

summary_zh.motivation: 为提升电子束熔融TC4钛合金的疲劳可靠性，需系统研究后处理热处理的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对SEBM沉积态TC4进行固溶时效处理（SAT），分析不同温度下微观组织演变和力学性能变化。
summary_zh.result: SAT处理使α相尺寸增大，950°C时篮网状组织转变为层片状，硬度降低而塑性提高，且疲劳强度和寿命均优于沉积态。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸、硬度和疲劳试验验证了热处理对组织和性能的改善效果。

summary_en.motivation: To ensure the reliability of mechanical properties for mass production of SEBM Ti-6Al-4V components, the effect of post-processing heat treatment on fatigue performance must be systematically investigated.
summary_en.method: A solution and aging treatment (SAT) was applied to as-deposited SEBM TC4 titanium alloy, and the microstructure evolution and mechanical properties were characterized at varying solution temperatures.
summary_en.result: After SAT, the α phase coarsened; at 950°C the basketweave structure transformed into lamellar structure, hardness decreased while plasticity increased, and both fatigue strength and life were enhanced compared to the as-deposited state.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing including tensile, hardness, and fatigue tests was conducted to validate the changes in microstructure and performance after heat treatment.

papers.title: Synergistic enhancement of tensile and high-cycle fatigue properties in wire direct energy deposition Ti-6Al-4V via hot isostatic pressing + solution treatment and aging treatment

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了热等静压与固溶时效处理对线弧直接能量沉积Ti-6Al-4V合金拉伸和疲劳性能的协同增强作用，完全符合后处理控制方向。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not cover other post-processing techniques such as machining, polishing, or shot peening; it focuses solely on HIP+STA combination.

summary_zh.motivation: 协同增强线弧直接能量沉积Ti-6Al-4V的拉伸与高周疲劳性能
summary_zh.method: 对沉积态试样进行热等静压+固溶时效复合后处理
summary_zh.result: 复合处理显著提升强度与疲劳寿命，优于单一处理
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸与高周疲劳测试并与不同处理态对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To synergistically enhance the tensile and high-cycle fatigue properties of wire direct energy deposition Ti-6Al-4V through combined hot isostatic pressing and solution treatment and aging.
summary_en.method: Applied hot isostatic pressing followed by solution treatment and aging on wire-DED Ti-6Al-4V specimens and conducted tensile and high-cycle fatigue tests.
summary_en.result: The combined post-processing significantly improved both tensile strength and fatigue life compared to as-built and single treatments.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical testing (tensile and high-cycle fatigue) with comparison to as-built and other heat-treated conditions.
